name: Chicken Alfredo Primavera
assumptions: Recipe instructions imply 4 servings based on typical pasta + protein + vegetable skillet meal scaling (16 oz dry pasta, 5 chicken breasts, large volume of vegetables).
Total active and passive time summed from sequential steps: chicken sauté (~15 min), pasta boil (~12 min overlapping), vegetable sauté and sauce (~12 min).
Butter and heavy cream and milk and Parmesan confirm dairy.
No eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, or sesame listed.
Parsley, wine, and vegetables introduce no additional allergens.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter and 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season both sides of each chicken breast with seasoned salt and a pinch of pepper. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.  While the chicken is cooking, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Season the boiling water with a few generous pinches of kosher salt. Add the pasta and give it a stir. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, about 12 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup of  pasta water before draining the pasta.  Remove the chicken from the pan and transfer it to a cutting board; allow it to rest. Turn the heat down to medium and dd the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter and olive oil to the same pan you used to cook the chicken. Add the veggies (minus the garlic) and red pepper flakes to the pan and stir to coat with the oil and butter (refrain from seasoning with salt until the veggies are finished browning). Cook, stirring often, until the veggies are tender, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and a generous pinch of salt and pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute.  Deglaze the pan with the white wine. Continue to cook until the wine has reduced by half, about 3 minutes. Stir in the milk, heavy cream, and reserved pasta water. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil and allow to simmer and reduce for 2-3 minutes. Turn off the heat and add the Parmesan cheese and cooked pasta. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley, if desired.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.assumptions: Standard butter; 1 tbsp = 14g so 2 tbsp total.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Olive oil; 1 tbsp ≈ 13.6g so 3 tbsp total.

ingredients.name: Chicken
ingredients.assumptions: 5 boneless, skinless chicken breasts; typical total raw weight ~1000g (≈200g each).

ingredients.name: Squash
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium yellow squash, raw, cubed; ≈200g edible portion.

ingredients.name: Broccoli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large head broccoli, chopped; typical edible raw weight ≈600g.

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.assumptions: 8 oz (227g) white mushrooms, raw, sliced; full package weight used.

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red bell pepper, raw; ≈150g edible portion after seeding.

ingredients.name: red pepper flakes
ingredients.assumptions: Crushed red pepper flakes; ½ tsp ≈ 1g; negligible macros.

ingredients.name: white wine
ingredients.assumptions: Dry white wine; ½ cup = 118 ml, density ≈1 g/ml.

ingredients.name: bowtie pasta
ingredients.assumptions: Dry bowtie (farfalle) pasta; 16 oz = 454g; values for uncooked as added to recipe.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of kosher salt; ≈1g; negligible macros.

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of black pepper; ≈1g; negligible macros.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: Chopped fresh parsley for garnish; typical small bunch portion ≈10g.
